# KRun

> Web Main docking docs for Kense KRun. Default version: 1.0.0.
> Public site: https://kense-labs.github.io/krun/

Product: KRun
Vendor: Kense
Audience: Web Main thin proxy only
NPM: @kense/krun
Not for: Renderer direct calls, business Core importing control APIs
Primary language: zh-CN
Information architecture: Diátaxis — 入门 / 实现 / 发版
Do not invent implementation details not stated in these pages.

2. [接入 Main](./runtime/1.0.0/integration/index.html) — install, serve, placement, session
3. [迁出本机旁路](./runtime/1.0.0/dock-delta/index.html) — local bypass → isolated runtime

### 实现
4. [调用配方](./runtime/1.0.0/recipes/index.html) — task-oriented Main call paths

### 发版
6. [发版检查](./runtime/1.0.0/operations/index.html) — visibility and release checklist

Machine-readable method groups: ./runtime/1.0.0/_atlas/api.json

## Glossary

| Term (zh) | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 放置 | Main chooses local bypass or isolated runtime |
| 会话端点 | Dial target provided by KRun for product sessions |
| 本机旁路 | Process runs on host machine; debug only |
| 隔离运行时 | Process runs in KRun-managed isolation; release default |
| 宿主能力 | Host tools admitted by contract and relayed by KRun |
| 工作区共享 | Workspace mounted by share_id |
| 合同 | Capability allowlists and status field shapes under contracts/ |

## Related

- @kense/krun
- optional platform packages (e.g. @kense/krun-darwin-arm64)
